prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” for everyone — the best Houston AC repair company for you depends on your ZIP code, whether it’s an emergency, budget, and whether you want a big company or a local shop. If you tell me your ZIP and needs I can pick the top-rated nearby options and give phone numbers.

If you want a quick start, well-regarded Houston options to consider
- John Moore Services — long-established, wide service area, good reviews, offers emergency service and warranties.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electric — locally based, strong residential reputation, techs for same-day repairs.
- ARS / Rescue Rooter (local franchise) — national backing, 24/7 availability, lots of technicians across Houston.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise of Neighborly) — fast-response branding, flat-rate pricing in many cases.
- Smaller independent shops — often cheaper and more personalized; look for one with many recent 4–5 star reviews.

How to choose the best company for you
- Verify credentials: insurance and registration with the Texas licensing authority (TDLR) or applicable local registration.  
- Read recent Google/Yelp/BBB reviews (last 12 months) for reliability and how they handle follow-ups/warranty work.  
- Ask about: diagnostic fee, estimated repair vs replacement costs, parts & labor warranty, brands they service, emergency/after-hours charges, and whether techs are NATE-certified.  
- Get at least 2 written estimates for any repair over ~$300.

Typical price/expectation tips (Houston ballpark)
- Service call/diagnostic: ~$75–150.  
- Common repairs: capacitor/contactor/fan motor/refrigerant leaks vary widely ($100s–$1,000+). Compressor replacement or major refrigerant work can run $1,200–3,000 or more. Always get written estimates.

If you want, tell me:
- your ZIP code, whether it’s emergency, and whether it’s residential or commercial — I’ll find top-rated, nearby AC repair companies, compare warranties/service hours, and give phone numbers and average price ranges.
